title: typo3-content-blocks: the skill at work
description: An element in one YAML file. Recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab: make:content-block in DDEV, then the new element in the content wizard of a test page. It was saved for real and removed afterwards. Narrated, with English captions.
alt: Film, 49 seconds: the typo3-content-blocks agent skill. make:content-block creates a teaser block in a TYPO3 v14 project, and config.yaml lists its headline, image and link fields. The new element appears in the content wizard and is saved. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: A new element once meant TCA, SQL, TypoScript and a template.
You ask for a teaser: headline, image, link.
make:content-block creates the block; the skill writes fields, template and preview.
The teaser shows up in the wizard. An editor fills it in and saves.
A renamed field leaves records that look empty.
